rule.assistant_manager: Assistant manager — share of team sales
rule.assistant_manager_certified: Certified assistant manager — 1/8 of sub-AM teams

ruleFormula.manager_certified_office: (price − product manager share) × opened-office % → Overed account

ruleHelp.manager_sale: The manager percentage is set on each product (product form). The manager, vice president and divisionnaire receive this share on their office production.
ruleHelp.assistant_manager: The assistant manager receives a share of their direct team's production: (sales ÷ divisor) × settings percent, deducted from the office manager's Salary account. Members who become assistant managers are excluded from that base.
ruleHelp.assistant_manager_certified: A certified assistant manager also receives 1/8 of the team production of each assistant manager in their team (that sub-AM's direct team), also deducted from the office manager's Salary account. This 1/8 is not the divisor of the rule above.
ruleHelp.assistant_manager_certified_hint: Divisor 4 is for the base share. The certified surplus (1/8 on sub-AM teams) is applied automatically and does not use this divisor.
ruleHelp.manager_office: The creator/lead of an office (manager, vice president or partner) receives this percentage of the office's turnover (after subtracting the product manager share) for the office they opened directly.
ruleHelp.manager_certified_office: Certified surplus credited to the Overed account: same % as “opened office”, calculated on price after removing the product manager share (e.g. 6000 − 1500 = 4500). Assistant managers do not take a share of this surplus.
ruleHelp.manager_descendant_office: The manager receives this percentage of sales from descendant offices (offices opened by their guys), after subtracting each office manager's percentage.
ruleHelp.divisionnaire_office: The divisionnaire receives this percentage of sales from offices in their hierarchy, after subtracting each office manager's percentage.
ruleHelp.secretary_office: The secretary receives this percentage of sales from the office opened by the manager they accompany, after subtracting that office manager's percentage. A fixed salary may be added separately.

ruleScope.manager_direct_office: Office opened by the accompanied manager
